newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom rises to 2,941 rbls at auction.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom rises to 2,941 rbls at auction.

text.p: A stake of 10 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Thursday at an average 2,941.48 roubles (54.5 cents) a share, up from 2,922.55 a week ago, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
The starting price at the regular auction was 2,776 roubles and lots sold for between 2,845 roubles and 3,019 roubles a share, the FFK said in a statement.
The stake represented 0.042 percent of Gazprom's capital. The FFK said that since auctions began in March, 169.75 million shares, equivalent to 0.71 percent of the capital, had changed hands.
Prices have risen from an average 406.6 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6.
Gazprom is Russia's biggest company by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid.
The company has orgnaised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom closed at 32.5 cents on the Russian Trading System.
The company is planning an international share issue.
